A puzzle game, focused on sliding tiles around. Basic gameplay involves placing tiles featuring girls together, then moving a “male” tile in to make them disappear. Later mechanics include ice floors, collapsing floors, and so on. After every few puzzles there’s a short scene, eventually leading to H.

item.title: Kyouiku Jisshuu ~Joshikousei Maniacs~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tetratech
  • 発売日: 1996-12-13
  • スコア: 6.07/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 教育実習 ～女子校生マニアックス～
  • 英語名: Kyouiku Jisshuu Joshikousei Maniacs

あらすじ

The plot of “Kyouiku Jisshuu Joshikousei Maniacs” is rather simple: the protagonist is an ordinary Japanese man named Shingo, who is about to become an intern in a prestigious school. There is only one thing that makes the young man slightly nervous: all his students will be girls. And if that weren’t enough, some of his new co-workers are young attractive women. Will Shingo concentrate on his job or succumb to the pleasures of the flesh?
